format: bio-dash waves v2 + rr_ms (R-R proof of concept)
method: one row every 8 ms (125 Hz) at whole multiples of 8 ms in epoch time; the ECG interpolated linearly at every instant from its two neighbouring samples (Bio-dash analysis_dashboard/waves.py, grid method; pieces end at ECG steps over max_gap_ms, pieces under min_piece_s left out); rr_ms: beat times rebuilt from the R-R messages (the chain of R-R intervals, anchored to the message arrival times), a straight line between the beats either side of each instant, dropouts interpolated across, rows outside the first..last beat left out, only R-R from the recording's own day, recordings without R-R left out (rr_poc/export_ecg_rr.py)
decode: ecg_uv: mV = value * 1 / 1000; rr_ms: ms = value

split.rule: training rows = the rows the ECG models trained on (the first 90% of the plain ECG export)

note: Per-recording list and source paths removed for the Hub copy (counts kept).
